subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt and retarget the conflicting fork PR, or close it and sponsor a current-main fix for Anthropic OAuth beta/header composition?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the only open closing PR is outside the main repository, conflicts, and targets removed files, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor current-main fix
options.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition with regression coverage for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget fork PR
options.body: Bring the fork work into the main repository, update it for the current direct transport and provider package paths, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for fork update
options.body: Leave this issue open until the fork author rebases and retargets the branch into a viable current-main landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current-main fix
recommendation.body: Create or approve a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport/header composition with regression coverage for OAuth plus model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent PR metadata point most directly to this provider/header area for choosing the landing path.
